title: Deferred VDBE table-cursor moveto completion

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeFinishMoveto completes an exact deferred table-rowid seek, passes through B-tree failures without clearing deferred state, reports corruption when the target row is absent, and only on exact success clears deferredMoveto and invalidates the row cache.

external_source_responsibilities: sqlite3BtreeTableMoveto exact-rowid seek and required B-tree locking
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete active non-test body is assigned behind a typed table-moveto seam; native opcode dispatch remains open.

inputs: Deferred native table VdbeCursor with B-tree implementation and movetoTarget
outputs: Exact B-tree error, SQLITE_CORRUPT for missing target, or SQLITE_OK with deferred state cleared and stale cache
contracts.ownership: Cursor pointers are borrowed; no allocation.
contracts.state_and_results: B-tree failure and nonzero seek comparison preserve deferredMoveto and cacheStatus. Exact success clears deferredMoveto and sets CACHE_STALE.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Table-moveto seam owns B-tree locking and pager reads.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Errors leave the deferred seek pending; exact success permits cursor consumers to continue.

representation_differences: A typed table-moveto seam represents sqlite3BtreeTableMoveto until native BtCursor execution is connected.
The inactive SQLITE_TEST search counter is excluded by the pinned production profile; the existing Cursor-union runtime helper remains a separate owner.

oracle.protocol: Drive deterministic B-tree error, missing-target, and exact-success outcomes against a native VdbeCursor and compare result, deferredMoveto, and cacheStatus.
oracle.normalization: Opaque BtCursor address is identity-only; result codes and scalar fields are exact. Pinned-C trace remains pending.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: B-tree seam owns I/O and locking.
assurance.malformed_input: Non-deferred, non-table, non-B-tree, or null implementation inputs violate source assertions.
assurance.continuation: Only exact success consumes the deferred seek.
assurance.performance: One B-tree table seek and constant-time state publication.

integration.native_call_path: Native-layout owner is compile- and unit-traced; runtime opcode path remains on src/core/vdbe.zig Cursor union.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No; simplified runtime owner remains active.

independent_review.notes: Requires native B-tree dispatch, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Dispatch native cursor consumers through this owner.

callers: Native-layout unit trace invokes the owner directly
